quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice 'finally' and the enthusiastic planning that follows right away.
quests.explanation: Starting to plan every room the moment you get new house keys is a clear sign of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: We finally got the keys to our new house. I've already started planning how to decorate every room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Listen for what the speaker missed and how they're judging themselves for it.
quests.explanation: Missing a loved one's funeral through no fault of your own, and blaming yourself anyway, is a deep and specific kind of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: The flight was cancelled and I couldn't make it to my grandmother's funeral. I'll never forgive myself.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice 'I know exactly' — the speaker has no doubt left about their preparation.
quests.explanation: Saying you know exactly what to say, after a full week of preparation, is a straightforward sign of confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've prepared for this presentation all week. I know exactly what to say and when to say it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice the gap between the promise and what actually happened.
quests.explanation: A promised one-hour callback that turns into three days, called 'ridiculous,' is a clear sign of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: They promised to call back within an hour, and that was three days ago. This is ridiculous.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'I can't believe it' is a direct signal — think about why this news didn't fit expectations.
quests.explanation: News that contradicts everything you expected from someone, like a quiet neighbor winning a national contest, is a clear cause of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: My quiet neighbor, who never talks to anyone, just won the national singing competition. I can't believe it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Checking something three times and still feeling uneasy points to a particular state of mind.
quests.explanation: Triple-checking and still feeling uneasy afterward is a familiar sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've triple-checked everything but I still feel like I've forgotten something important.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about the mood of an evening spent laughing with people you love.
quests.explanation: Hours spent talking and laughing with family over dinner is a warm, simple picture of happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: My whole family came for dinner last night. We sat at the table for hours just talking and laughing.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Always wanted to know' tells you exactly how the speaker feels about this mystery.
quests.explanation: 'Always wanted to know what's inside' is a direct, simple statement of curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: There's a locked door at the end of the hallway that nobody ever opens. I've always wanted to know what's inside.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about what it means when someone stops listening because a topic drags on.
quests.explanation: Tuning out after forty minutes on the same topic is a clear, relatable sign of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: He's been talking about the same topic for forty minutes. I've completely stopped listening.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about what finding someone's old letters might stir up.
quests.explanation: Sitting on the floor to read every one of someone's old letters suggests a quiet, personal sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I found her old letters while cleaning the house. I sat on the floor and read every single one.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Listen for the result and how the speaker reacts to this personal win.
quests.explanation: Winning first place out of two hundred entries is exactly the kind of news that produces real excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The competition results just came in — and I won! First place out of over two hundred entries!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The word 'furious' is a direct label — what emotion does it name?
quests.explanation: 'Absolutely furious' is a strong, direct word choice that clearly names intense anger.
quests.textToSpeak: Someone walked into my office and moved all my things without permission. I was absolutely furious.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: This sentence is giving information only — does the speaker share any personal feeling?
quests.explanation: Plain opening-hours information, with no emotional language attached, is a good example of a neutral tone.
quests.textToSpeak: The store closes at nine on Thursdays and stays open until ten on Fridays.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Compare what she said first with what she then revealed.
quests.explanation: A flat contradiction like 'never visited another country' followed by 'lived in Tokyo for eight years' is a natural cause of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: She said she'd never visited another country, then casually mentioned she'd lived in Tokyo for eight years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about why someone would reread something they've already sent.
quests.explanation: Rereading a form you've already submitted, out of worry about mistakes, is a common sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I keep rereading my application. I've submitted it, but I'm not sure if everything was filled in correctly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'My heart felt full' describes a warm feeling — what emotion is that?
quests.explanation: 'Heart felt full' is a common idiom for a deep, warm sense of happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter called from the other side of the world just to say she was thinking of me. My heart felt full.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Intrigued' is a synonym hiding in plain sight — which option means the same thing?
quests.explanation: 'Intrigued' by not knowing what's coming is simply another word for curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The restaurant has no menu and the chef decides what you eat. I have no idea what I'll get, but I'm intrigued.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice the comparison the speaker makes to a harder situation in the past.
quests.explanation: Comparing tonight to a tougher past experience, and expecting no trouble, is a clear expression of confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've driven this route in far worse weather than this. Tonight's drive will be no problem at all.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about what a shared routine feels like the first time you do it alone.
quests.explanation: Doing a routine you once shared, alone for the first time, points to someone missing — a natural cause of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: We used to walk this path together every Sunday. I walked it alone today for the first time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice the repeated request and how the speaker reacts to it being ignored.
quests.explanation: Asking twice and still being ignored, then saying 'unbelievable,' is a familiar way to express anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I specifically asked for no onions — twice! And they put onions on it anyway. Unbelievable!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about the kind of anticipation that makes someone say they can barely breathe.
quests.explanation: Being unable to breathe during a rocket launch countdown is a vivid way to describe intense excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The countdown is at five seconds. I can barely breathe — this rocket is about to launch!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about how it feels to run out of anything fresh to watch.
quests.explanation: Having watched everything twice, with nothing new left, is a classic description of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: I've watched everything on this streaming service twice already. There's nothing new here.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about what happens when an event is completely hidden from the person it's for.
quests.explanation: Walking into a room full of people you didn't expect is one of the clearest everyday examples of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: I thought I was meeting one friend for coffee. I walked in and twenty people jumped up and yelled happy birthday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Stage fright' is named directly — what physical signs go along with it here?
quests.explanation: Sweating palms and no appetite are physical symptoms the speaker links to stage fright, which is a form of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: My palms are sweating and I can't eat anything. I wonder if this is what stage fright feels like.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Heart is soaring' despite tired legs signals a particular feeling.
quests.explanation: 'Heart is soaring' is an idiom for great joy, even when the body is worn out from effort.
quests.textToSpeak: I ran my first marathon today. My legs are exhausted, but my heart is absolutely soaring.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Keep wondering' is the key phrase — what does it tell you about the speaker's interest?
quests.explanation: 'Keep wondering' about someone else's thoughts is a simple, ongoing expression of curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The old man sits at the same bench every morning and stares at the fountain. I keep wondering what he's thinking about.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about the feeling of seeing strangers in a place full of personal memories.
quests.explanation: Seeing strangers in a garden full of childhood memories brings a quiet sense of loss and sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: The house sold yesterday. I drove past and saw strangers in the garden where we used to play.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about how an hour of waiting, followed by being turned away, would make you feel.
quests.explanation: An hour of waiting followed by being sent away with no solution is a common trigger for anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I've been waiting in line for an hour, and now they're telling me the system is down and I have to come back tomorrow!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Ready for whatever they throw at me' signals a particular attitude toward a challenge.
quests.explanation: Inviting any question after ten years of study is a direct, natural way to express confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've studied this subject for ten years. Ask me anything — I'm ready for whatever they throw at me.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice the complete contrast between what the speaker expected and what actually happened.
quests.explanation: Expecting bad news and getting the opposite instead is a strong, clear setup for surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: My boss called me into her office. I thought I was in trouble. She gave me a raise and a promotion.
